definitions.explanation: In a manner that is fitting, correct, and well-suited to the situation. Used in formal and professional contexts to describe actions done the right way.

examples.japanese: {適切|てきせつ}に⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{適切|てきせつ}に⟦{管理|かんり}する→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It is necessary to manage data properly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{適切|てきせつ}に⟦{判断|はんだん}できる→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: What matters is whether you can make appropriate judgments when problems arise.

notes:
The adverbial form of ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧ (appropriate, suitable), formed by adding ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Very common in business, official, and technical writing. It implies meeting a standard of correctness rather than just being "good enough."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {適切|てきせつ}に⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to respond appropriately
- {適切|てきせつ}に⟦{管理|かんり}する→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧: to manage properly
- {適切|てきせつ}に⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to process/handle properly
- {適切|てきせつ}に⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to judge appropriately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧: correctly — focuses on factual accuracy; {適切|てきせつ}に emphasizes fitness for purpose
- ⟦{的確|てきかく}→的確：04536_tekikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: accurately, precisely — emphasizes hitting the mark; more about precision
- ⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: appropriately / carelessly — ambiguous: can mean "suitably" or "halfheartedly" depending on context
